Messages.Author: Killjoy71
Messages.Body:
Can a minion have multiple despiral played on it?

Do the effects of multiple despirals stack?

Despiral

Action
Ishtarri

+1 stealth action.
Put this card on this Ishtarri and put 1 counter on this card. This Ishtarri gets +X bleed, where X is the number of counters on this card. This Ishtarri can add a counter to this card as a +1 stealth action that costs X blood

VTES is not for the faint of heart...especially when you don't have a enough blood.

Prince Of Geneva

Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
Yes. Unless a card is unique or explicitly states that a minion can only have one, then you can put as many as you like on the same minion.
Also, yes they do stack, for the same reason (it would have to explicitly state if they didn't).

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: To be precise, you take an action to power up ONE despiral, not ALL. So, putting a second despiral on the same vampire serve only to cycle and economize some blood.
